# My App — Full Documentation for AI Agents

> My Next.js application with shadcn/ui and theme support.
> Build something great.

## Product Overview

My App is a SaaS platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
It provides authentication, multi-tenant workspaces, team management,
billing, internationalization (8 languages), and a full blog/changelog CMS.

## Key Features

- **Authentication**: OAuth-based auth with multi-tenant workspace support via BuildBase SDK.
- **Multi-tenancy**: Workspace creation, switching, and role-based access control (admin, editor, viewer, member).
- **Internationalization**: 8 languages (English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic) with RTL support.
- **Blog & CMS**: MDX-powered blog with authors, tags, categories, drafts, search, RSS feeds.
- **Changelog**: Product update log with highlights, versioning, and RSS feed.
- **Pricing**: Dynamic pricing plans with multi-currency and billing interval support.
- **SEO**: Comprehensive schema.org structured data, sitemaps, hreflang, Open Graph.
- **Theme**: Light/dark/system mode with shadcn/ui component library.

## Pages

### Public Pages
- `/` — Home page with product overview.
- `/pricing` — Pricing plans with monthly/quarterly/yearly billing and multi-currency support.
- `/about` — Company information, mission, and values.
- `/blog` — Blog index with posts, categories, tags, search, and pagination.
- `/blog/{slug}` — Individual blog post with table of contents, share buttons, related posts.
- `/blog/authors/{slug}` — Author profile page with bio and post history.
- `/blog/tag/{tag}` — Posts filtered by tag.
- `/blog/category/{category}` — Posts filtered by category.
- `/changelog` — Product changelog with release highlights.
- `/changelog/{slug}` — Individual changelog entry with full details.
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy.
- `/terms` — Terms of service.

### Protected Pages (require authentication)
- `/dashboard` — User dashboard with workspace overview.
- `/dashboard/settings` — User and workspace settings.
- `/dashboard/team` — Team member management.
- `/dashboard/documents` — Document management.
- `/dashboard/analytics` — Analytics and reporting.
- `/dashboard/notifications` — Notification center.

## Feeds

- `/blog/feed.xml` — Blog RSS 2.0 feed (per-locale).
- `/changelog/feed.xml` — Changelog RSS 2.0 feed (per-locale).

## API Endpoints

- `GET /api/health` — Health check (returns 200 OK).
- `POST /api/auth/token` — OAuth token exchange.
- `GET /api/auth/session` — Current session info.
- `POST /api/auth/signout` — Sign out.
- `GET /api/og` — Dynamic Open Graph image generation.

## Technology Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router)
- **Language**: TypeScript 5 (strict mode)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- **Authentication**: BuildBase SDK (OAuth 2.0)
- **Content**: Contentlayer2 (MDX)
- **Monitoring**: Sentry
- **Deployment**: Vercel, Docker

## Structured Data

Every page includes schema.org JSON-LD structured data:
- Organization, WebSite (root layout)
- BlogPosting, ArticleJsonLd (blog posts, changelog entries)
- BreadcrumbList (navigation context)
- Person (author profiles)
- WebApplication, Product, AggregateOffer (pricing page)
- ItemList (changelog index)
- Blog (blog index)

## Internationalization

Supported locales: en, hi, es, fr, de, ja, zh, ar
Default locale: en (no URL prefix)
Non-default locales: /{locale}/path (e.g., /es/pricing)
RTL support: Arabic (ar)
